usage: Use 柳樹 for a willow tree, a tree with long, hanging branches.
Common in descriptions of parks, riversides, gardens, and nature scenes.
Usually a countable noun: one 柳樹, two 柳樹.
Natural in simple vocabulary; a good word for talking about trees in everyday life.
